exemplars.title: GANSpiration: Balancing Targeted and Serendipitous Inspiration in User Interface Design with Style-Based Generative Adversarial Network
exemplars.why: GANSpiration is the cleanest structural match: it ingests the user’s preliminary design image, encodes that artifact into latent conditioning state, and uses it to generate design inspiration whose output changes with the supplied draft.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: It ranks above CareerCraft because the evidence establishes an unambiguous artifact-to-conditioning-state path, without relying partly on text that may have been authored specifically for the interaction.

exemplars.title: CareerCraft: Supporting New Graduates on Job Hunting with LLM-Assisted Self-Construction of Career Profile
exemplars.why: CareerCraft exposes a concrete ingestion-and-transformation pipeline in which user-uploaded documents and prior reflections are processed by an LLM into predefined experience cards, turning material the user already has into structured generative output.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: It ranks above the immersive-diary exemplar because its document-to-structured-record mechanism is more readily transferable across domains and more directly illustrates the stated structured-fields sub-pattern.

exemplars.title: From Photos to Immersive Memories: Awakening the Past with Panoramic Environments
exemplars.why: The system conditions generation on a clearly pre-existing, multimodal personal artifact—diary text, photographs, and EXIF metadata—and transforms those records into a VR environment intended to preserve their original context.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: It ranks above TubeLens because the evidence identifies the ingested source representations and their generated destination more concretely, while TubeLens leaves the watch-history import and inference pipeline unspecified.

notes: I promoted GANSpiration from third to first because its quote most completely exposes the structural signature: artifact ingestion, latent encoding, and downstream transformation. I retained CareerCraft but placed it second because its uploaded-document path is strong while its free-text reflections may have been produced for the workflow. I selected the immersive-memory system over consensus runner-up TubeLens: TubeLens is conceptually compelling, but its high rater spread and missing import/consent and inference details make it weaker as a reconstructable structural exemplar. Readers should also distrust any implication that the available quotes fully document the interfaces: GANSpiration’s quote omits the later generation controls, CareerCraft does not distinguish pre-existing from workflow-authored reflections, and the immersive-memory quote does not specify its capture or upload interaction.
